credit: a tribute to Slender: The Eight Pages
end_lose_sub: You cannot outrun him. You can only refuse to look.
end_win_sub:
Eight pages. The forest lets you go.
For now.
how_body:
You are alone in a dark forest. Eight pages are pinned to landmarks: a stone labyrinth, a tunnel, a silo, a truck, a shed, a ring of stones, a ruined bathroom and a watchtower.

Collect all eight, then get out.

He appears at the edge of the trees. Looking at him slows him down — but if you stare too long he will know, and he will run.

Static is his voice. When it rises, look away — or run.

hud_touch: LEFT STICK — MOVE     RIGHT SIDE — LOOK     HOLD RUN TO SPRINT
title_subtitle: a forest · eight notes · one tall figure
toast_intro: FIND THE EIGHT PAGES  —  DO NOT STARE AT HIM
note_1:
1

HELP ME.

I cannot find the way out. The trees keep moving.
note_2:
2

He is tall. Taller than the trees.

Do not look at his face.
note_3:
3

It only moves when you look away.

Keep your eyes on the path.
note_4:
4

I counted eight. There were eight.

Now there are seven.
note_5:
5

Don't run. He hears running.

Walk. Breathe. Count.
note_6:
6

The static in your ears is his voice.

When it gets loud, close your eyes.
note_7:
7

It is always behind you.

Always.
note_8:
8

I found them all. Eight pages.

Why is he still here?
